cells.gaps: No report of practice says the entry made at the conservatória is held in the national register: CPV-008 (2017) does not say where the record is held, CPV-001 (2025) does not say the entry is made at the office, and CPV-003 and CPV-005 are what the law prescribes, which places nothing. The office share is 22 of 22 municipalities from a profile compiled to November 2017, with stations in urban centres only; nothing newer gives a share or a rural share. No governance fact is dated inside the 36 months and no event inside the twelve.
cells.note: Births and deaths are entered directly in the computer at conservatórias in all 22 municipalities, which meets stage 3. Stage 4 needs `connected` from the fact's own words, and the only rows that say it are legal provisions.
